jobs.title: GTM, Enterprise
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: Customers, customers, customers. You’ll sell to enterprise customers, build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, and turn real demand into revenue. You’ll operate with judgment, adapt to how each customer works, and consistently get deals done.

You: Curious, first principles thinker, relentless, competitive. Can't be put in a box. You are an experienced Enterprise seller who has previously held GTM roles for technical products. You don't like to lose.

Life at Parallel

Our team works fully in-person, between our Palo Alto HQ and San Francisco office. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.

We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

  • Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.

  • Obsess over craft: Perfect every detail because quality compounds.

  • Accelerate change: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.

  • Create win-wins: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.

  • Make high-conviction bets: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous equity

  • Visa sponsorships

jobs.title: Early Career Research Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

About you

You're a researcher who thinks like an engineer, or an engineer who thinks like a researcher. You've worked on information retrieval systems, embedding models, or neural ranking at scale, or you're deeply curious about the fundamental problems that emerge when training models to understand and serve billions of web documents. You thrive in the space between theory and production, where elegant solutions must also run efficiently on real infrastructure. You're comfortable reading papers from SIGIR and RecSys one day and debugging distributed training pipelines the next.

The role

You'll design and train the models that power Parallel's APIs: the intelligence layer that helps AI agents find exactly what they need from the open web. This means tackling research problems that most labs encounter only at hyperscale: How do you train embedding models that capture semantic intent across diverse query types? How do you balance model expressiveness with sub-second retrieval latency? How do you maintain index freshness when the web updates constantly, without rebuilding from scratch?

Unlike traditional search engines built for human queries, you're building for AI agents that issue complex, multi-hop queries and expect structured, programmatic responses. This is information retrieval reimagined for the LLM era, work that combines classical IR techniques with modern deep learning, applied at a scale that demands new solutions.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. The role:

You will build and operate the systems that let Parallel run its own large-scale full-text index over the web. You will work across the full lifecycle: deciding what belongs in the corpus, building the searchable structures that hold it, building the signals and models that judge source quality and freshness, and serving queries against the index quickly and economically. You will anticipate bottlenecks before they appear and ensure the architecture evolves to meet increasing demand.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. The role:

You will own the multi-stage ranking pipeline that narrows a web-scale set of candidates down to the handful of best passages for a query, spending the least compute necessary to do it well. You will push precision and recall across fast candidate retrieval, lightweight first-pass ranking, and heavier neural reranking, decide how much compute each query deserves, and grade everything on real usage outcomes rather than offline proxies.

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

Job: You'll lead Parallel's AI-native sales team, working alongside the most talent-dense GTM leaders and ICs in the business. You'll carry a piece of the pipeline yourself, running discovery and closing cycles against technical, AI-forward buyers so your coaching comes from doing the work, not just watching it. You'll build the playbook for selling into teams that are already building with agents and LLMs, sharpen the ramp and coaching rhythm that gets new reps productive fast, and scale the team as pipeline grows. You'll partner with the head of Recruiting to build a dream team and with the head of GTM on segmentation. You've sold to technical buyers — founders, engineers, ML leads — and can hold your own in a conversation about LLMs, agents, or RAG without a technical co-pilot in the room. You thrive when the product spec, the buyer's use case, and the competitive landscape all shift in the same week, and you know how to keep a deal moving when the ground underneath it won't sit still. Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: You'll own product enablement for GTM, sitting at the intersection of engineering and go-to-market. You'll build and run product bootcamps, ongoing technical training, and enablement for every major capability we launch, then turn that knowledge into demos, eval templates, and technical collateral the GTM team can pick up and use on their own. You'll partner with engineering and marketing to build customer-facing technical content that helps buyers evaluate Parallel, and with Deployed Engineering to turn what they learn in individual deals into scalable resources for the broader team. You’ll spend roughly 80% of your time building and enabling and 20% staying close to live deals to keep everything you build grounded in real customer conversations and challenges.

You: You've been a Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Solutions Engineer for a highly technical product and/or have a strong engineering background. You have 2-3+ years in tech, ideally at a fast-moving startup, and you're fluent with modern AI tools because you use them constantly in your own work. You can write code, quickly understand a customer’s technical challenges, and make complex products clear enough that anyone can pick them up and run with them. Beyond technical fluency, you understand how great sales teams operate and have strong instincts for what helps them win. Product or technical enablement experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

Life at Parallel

Our team works fully in-person, between our Palo Alto HQ and San Francisco office. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.

We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will build and operate the security systems that let Parallel ship quickly without creating avoidable risk. You will work across application security, secure defaults, AI-assisted security tooling, and the unique attack surface of agentic systems that consume untrusted web content. You will fix real vulnerabilities when they appear, then change the underlying systems so the same class of issue is harder to introduce again.

You will also help define how security fits into the development process: building reusable patterns for authentication, authorization, data handling, and outbound access, designing controls for enterprise customers, and ensuring security review happens as part of how software gets built rather than as a separate process at the end.

About you:

Have deep intuition on application security, software architecture, and how vulnerabilities emerge in real systems. You are comfortable finding issues yourself, but care more about eliminating vulnerability classes through better libraries, frameworks, and defaults.

You still like to write production code and have strong opinions on where current AI models are useful for security work and where they mostly create noise. You are comfortable operating independently, prioritizing the highest-leverage problems, and working directly with both engineers and customers.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Significant software engineering experience, including several years focused on product or application security

  • Strong experience with web and API security, including authentication, authorization, SSRF, IDOR, injection, and multi-tenant isolation

  • Built frameworks, libraries, or secure defaults that reduced entire classes of vulnerabilities across a codebase or engineering organization

  • Experience building security tooling using current AI models, such as automated code review, threat modeling, triage, agent harnesses, or evaluation systems

  • Experience securing systems that process untrusted inputs, especially LLM or agentic systems

  • Ability to work independently as the primary security owner and make clear prioritization decisions

  • Strong production coding skills in Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar languages

About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

The role:

You will build and operate the security foundations that protect Parallel’s production infrastructure, internal systems, and access to both. You will own how people, services, and agents authenticate, what they can reach, how production is hardened, and how security controls are enforced from source code through running workloads.

You will work across identity and access, cloud and Kubernetes security, software supply chain integrity, logging and detection infrastructure, endpoint security, and recovery. You will design secure defaults engineers inherit rather than configure, and build the systems that make access, changes, and recovery measurable and auditable.

You will also help define how AI coding agents operate inside Parallel’s own infrastructure, including what they can access, what privileges they receive, and how their actions are constrained and logged.

About you:

Have deep intuition on cloud infrastructure, identity, network security, and production systems. You like to reason about which controls materially reduce risk and which ones mostly create process.

You write and ship code, prefer automation over manual controls, and are comfortable working at the boundary between security, platform engineering, and reliability. You can land changes across teams you do not manage, make practical tradeoffs, and build durable security foundations rather than controls that need constant tending.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • Significant experience building or operating infrastructure or security systems in production cloud environments

  • Deep experience in at least one of identity and authorization, cloud and Kubernetes security, or logging and detection platforms

  • Strong cloud, network, secrets management, and workload isolation fundamentals

  • Experience building secure deployment pipelines, including artifact provenance, immutability, secret scanning, and software supply chain controls

  • Experience designing centralized logging, alerting, and detection infrastructure across cloud, SaaS, identity, and endpoints

  • Strong production coding and automation skills in Terraform, Python, Go, or similar tools

  • A track record of shipping security controls across an engineering organization, including making tradeoffs to get them adopted

  • Experience with endpoint security, device trust, recovery planning, SOC 2, customer audits, or contractual security requirements is a plus

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: We’re hiring a senior brand designer who’s a generalist first, with a particular strength in technical storytelling and information design. You’ll help explain a deeply technical product to a wider audience, and apply and extend our brand system across the work we put into the world.

You’ll be part of the design team, working closely with technical marketing and DevRel to shape the story from the first outline. The work includes diagrams, benchmark and eval visualizations, docs and API illustrations, and visual essays like The Web as Ground Truth. You’ll also work across launch pages, blog art direction, conference and keynote graphics, motion, and social.

You: Your portfolio shows strong typography, composition, and range across brand, web, and motion. You can learn a complex subject, find the idea that matters, and explain it at different levels of depth. You bring ideas to the narrative and are comfortable working through them in prototypes and motion. Experience with developer or technical products is a plus, as is a strong writing instinct. You can handle a high volume of work, make good decisions quickly, and follow through on the production details.

About Parallel Design: We design for a web used by both people and agents, grounding our work in real code, data, and evidence. We draw from the history of the web, computing, and publishing to help explain what comes next, while leaving room for experiments, tangents, and things made simply because they’re good.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

Job: You will own positioning and go-to-market for Index, Parallel’s marketplace for the agentic web. Agent builders get grounded access to high-quality content; publishers, data providers, and creators see how agents use their work and earn from what it contributes. You’ll make the case to both sides: to agent builders, from AI-native startups to the largest enterprises, why Index content produces better answers, and to content owners, from news publishers to independent creators, why they should join, what they learn, and how they earn. You’ll lead launches, new content categories, and the move to self-serve, build proof programs with launch partners, and shape the public narrative on how the open web stays sustainable when agents become its largest users, alongside the founding team.

You: Have owned positioning for a product line or company and have marketed a two-sided marketplace or platform. You know how to balance supply and demand, and when one side has to come first. You understand how agents use the web and hold your own with engineers and researchers. You’re comfortable defending a narrative that press, publishers, and the AI community will scrutinize. Media, data licensing, or usage-based monetization experience is a plus. You ask why until the answer is real.
